rows.cause: Obsolete child edges are removed without decrementing or resetting Expert.num_invalid_children. A necessary parent retaining this count becomes invalid at its next computation despite valid prospective children.

rows.approach: Prospective child traversal and object ownership checks precede remove-all/add-all application. Removal decrements invalid-child counts using the existing state machinery; callback publication and no-op identity checks remain intact.

Prospective DFS and ownership validation precede complete replacement. Invalid old children decrement the existing count; all new child arrays are installed before necessity reconnects. Existing node identities and heap helpers remain in use.
